page.overview:
Who is Basketball Wizard?

Basketball Wizard is a character who appears in Issue 12 of the Adventure Time comic book series. He registers to take part in the wizard battle being organized by Finn, Jake and Marceline during their search for Ewlbo. Marceline beats him up for stealing all of her basketballs.

Basketball Wizard is an actual animate basketball, with long orange legs and no visible arms. He wears a red wizard's hat, a pair of red boxer shorts, and a pair of red tinted goggles. He has a small brown beard and mustache.
